title: This Wall Street firm's AI calculator has bad news for vibe coders
excerpt: Should companies build or buy software? An RBC analysis finds custom AI apps are often more expensive than SaaS.
content_html:
Should you build or buy software? This Wall Street firm has a new tool to decide.

By Alistair Barr

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Author of the Tech Memo newsletter

The build-versus-buy debate around business software has a new calculator.

Last year, I wrote about how AI coding tools were making it easier for companies to create their own internal apps instead of paying an outside software provider.

That shift raised a tempting question: Why keep buying expensive software when employees can now vibe code a custom version themselves?

The enterprising analysts at RBC Capital Markets recently built an interactive tool to test that idea. Companies and investors can plug in the cost of a software subscription, then compare it with the full cost of building and running an in-house alternative.

The tool goes beyond the initial coding bill. It also includes maintenance, security risks, repairs, and the cost of employees using a tool that may be less reliable or capable.

RBC's conclusion is sobering: Building your own version of business software is usually more expensive than buying it. The math can work for simpler, less important tools, but rarely for core systems such as payroll, customer records, or office software.

The biggest hidden cost may be talent. Even when a custom app is possible, companies must ask whether their best AI workers should rebuild existing software or create something genuinely new.

围绕商业软件的构建与购买争论有了一个新的计算器。

去年，我写了一篇关于人工智能编码工具如何让公司更轻松地创建自己的内部应用程序而不是向外部软件提供商付费的文章。

这种转变提出了一个诱人的问题：当员工现在可以自己编写自定义版本时，为什么还要继续购买昂贵的软件呢？

加拿大皇家银行资本市场（RBC Capital Markets）富有进取心的分析师最近开发了一个交互式工具来测试这个想法。 公司和投资者可以输入软件订阅的成本，然后将其与构建和运行内部替代方案的全部成本进行比较。

该工具超出了最初的编码范围。 它还包括维护、安全风险、维修以及员工使用可能不太可靠或能力较差的工具的成本。

加拿大皇家银行的结论发人深省：构建自己版本的商业软件通常比购买更昂贵。 数学可以适用于更简单、不太重要的工具，但很少适用于薪资、客户记录或办公软件等核心系统。

最大的隐性成本可能是人才。 即使定制应用程序是可能的，公司也必须问他们最好的人工智能员工是否应该重建现有软件或创建真正的新软件。
